transcript.answer:
## Czech Wikipedia: Clear decline in intermittent fasting interest

Czech Wikipedia shows a **declining** trend. Views of the "Přerušovaný půst" (intermittent fasting) article fell **47.7%** over the last 12 months (September 2025 – August 2026 vs. the same months a year earlier), with a 90% confidence range of -62.5% to -27.9%. This decline was **consistent** — 11 of 12 months showed lower views than the year before. Medium confidence reflects some spike days (April 2025, August 2025) whose causes are unknown.

The article averaged 146 views per month across the 24-month window.

## Polish Wikipedia: Not directly covered

Polish Wikipedia doesn't have a dedicated article on intermittent fasting. However, I can compare using two broader proxies if you'd like:

1. **"Post" (Fasting in general)** — broader category, measures general interest in fasting, not specifically intermittent fasting
2. **"Dieta" (Diet)** — even broader, would measure diet interest generally

Would you like me to add Polish data using one of these proxies? The results would show a different signal — general fasting or diet trends rather than intermittent fasting specifically.
